GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-11-26T14:04:04Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Hosting bundle IIS reset / application pool recycle question
Description: Hi,
I'm currently working on expanding a setup application that downloads applications and puts them in a IIS folder. Some of the applications are asp. net core which require the hosting bundle to be installed. The setup module will install the bundle if it not found on the found on the target machine(which runs the setup application). When i was testing the bundle installer i saw in the eventlog all the application pools where recycled. 

- Why is this recycle started? 
    - Is this due to a IIS reset?  

The only thing i could think of was for the environment path that is added for the dotnet.exe location but we install everything in the default folders(C:\Program Files\dotnet).  

The web.configs for our asp.net core application all have a full path to the dotnet exe path. 

- Is the recycle necessary? 
    - Is there a way to turn this recycle off if it not necessary?

I'm asking this because the customers where the applications are being installed can also have other application running on IIS and we don't want to disturb there process. 

Kind regards,

Walter
